t: You're in Campden Hill Square, a garden square in Kensington, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Margaret Aston was born here in 1932. She became a historian, specialising in the Late Medieval period and in ecclesiastical history, which is the history of the church. During her career she lectured at both Oxford and Cambridge. She was known by her first married name, Aston, though she was born Margaret Evelyn Buxton. She died in 2014.
